name: Content translation access
description: Grants content-translation operations (create/translate/delete translation) per entity type + bundle, gated by the languages assigned to the current user.
project_description:
Content Translation Access provides granular permissions to control access to translated content.

It allows site builders to define who can view, create, and edit translations for specific content types,

giving teams precise control over multilingual workflows.

 Features 
 
 Defines specific permissions for content translation access. 
 Restricts or grants the ability to create , edit , or view translations per content type. 
 Helps manage multilingual workflows by controlling access at a fine-grained level. 
 Ideal for organizations where not all roles should have full translation rights based on language. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
After enabling the module, visit People → Permissions to configure translation-related permissions.

Assign the new permissions to the appropriate roles to control which users can view, create, or edit translations

for different content types. No additional configuration screens are required.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 Requires the core Content Translation module to be enabled. 
 Depends on Drupal core issue #2918354 for hook support. 
 
 Recommended 
 
 
 Drupal core issue #3056020 :

 Once resolved, it may replace the need for this module by providing native functionality.
 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 
This module was originally developed by KEY-TEC .

It is now maintained by Metadrop to ensure ongoing stability,

security coverage, and compatibility with Drupal 10.5 and 11.

If you would like to support ongoing maintenance and improvements, please do not hesitate to contact us.
